item.title: EscapeOS v0.1.5
item.description:
EscapeOS 0.1.5 | EscapeOS-0.1.5
## EscapeOS 0.1.5
v0.1.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.3, and v0.1.4 are unchanged.
### Added - **Reclaim** tab ranks apps by Safe cache and temp size (`tmp`, `Library/Caches`, logs, splash snapshots, GPU cache) - Per-app Reclaim Space from App Detail; Session buckets (cookies, WebKit, HTTP storage) are opt-in - Batch reclaim is Safe-only. Documents, Preferences, and Application Support are never reclaimed - Opening an app after a tab scan reuses those Safe sizes instead of measuring again - Locked cache files (permission denied, e.g. some `Library/Caches/FileData` folders) are skipped instead of failing the whole reclaim - **Reset App Data** on App Detail empties Documents, Library, and tmp. Keychain and App Groups are not touched. Resetting EscapeOS itself warns that the pairing file will be deleted
Hardware-checked on iPhone 17, iOS 26.5.1. After install, reconnect LocalDevVPN if the list is empty; iPASide places `pairingFile.plist` again after sideload. Close the target app before reclaiming or resetting.
